source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Submit each applicable incident report to the Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Office within 24 hours via one of the options listed on the Incident Report Form. 3. Report any other reportable accidents, including near-miss and property damage only reports to the EHS Office by completing an Accident Report Form. 4. When possible, look for the following items when completing the near-miss incident report: 1. Attach any relevant photos 2. Identify witnesses and interview them 3. Identify the parties involved and interview them. 4. Note actions taken to prevent recurrence (corrective actions) 5. Note any damaged items 5. Provide copies of any official reports. 6. Provide copies of pertinent photos. 7. For additional questions, contact the Risk Management Department.

Reportable Incidents

Reportable incidents include: * Accidents where property damage exceeds $500
